about: Where a session root's grant records live: <home>/.claude/tstack-grants/<sha256 of the root's realpath, UTF-8, lowercase hex>/. The plugin's hook (hooks/tstack-hook.py _records_dir, scripts/tests/test_tstack_hook.py) and the office host (fleet-ship apps/host/src/grants.ts) must both read these cases the same: copy this file there and change all copies together.
